info.name: skia-vulkan
info.output_format: Ganesh Vulkan render target, RGBAF16 premultiplied (linear Display P3; encoded sRGB for a scene whose root composites encoded)
info.precision: Skia blends in f32 premultiplied; output is f16 (≈11-bit mantissa)
info.color_note: scene colours converted working-space→linear-P3 f32 unclamped; readback f16→f32
info.encode_scope: replays pre-resolved `Canvas` draw calls — Ganesh records them into the deferred display list `submit` flushes

gpu_timing_unavailable: This Skia Ganesh Vulkan version does not implement GPU timing statistics
completion_signal: the kernel's signal timestamp (CLOCK_MONOTONIC) of the sync file exported from a binary semaphore Ganesh signals once the frame's flush has executed (FlushInfo::set_signal_semaphores): the driver's own fence time, read after the run drains. The semaphore is created and exported outside the timed submit, which only attaches it to the flush. A sync file exported already signaled carries no time; that frame's instant is then the export's return, an upper bound
